## Overview

This section brings together **pre-packaged courses and workshops** built from curated tutorial collections.\
Each course is designed for a specific teaching context at **TU Delft**, supporting both structured education and self-guided learning.

Each course page typically includes: - Learning objectives - Required software and data - Step-by-step tutorials - Assignments or exercises (when applicable) - Additional resources
